maria (sales_eng): FYI: FinFlow POC starts Monday. Need a compact provisioning runbook covering: Hosted API key, Dedicated pool (2x A100), and VPC peering. Who takes which steps and what's the minimum to get them running? cc @kevin (solutions) @anya (security)

kevin (solutions): Owners summary: sales_eng (maria) for hosted key and customer comms; infra (liu) for dedicated pool + peering; security (anya) for signoff. Minimal steps: 1) create hosted key scoped to project; 2) submit infra form for dedicated GPU pool; 3) set up VPC peering + route tables + IP allowlist; 4) smoke test generate + measure latency/cost.

anya (security): Security checklist to attach: required region/data residency, KMS/BYOK, SSO (SAML/OIDC) setup, audit log retention (90d default), allowed CIDRs, whether customer will send PII. Need their network contact and completed security questionnaire (use our template).

liu (infra): Infra minimal details:
- Dedicated pool request (form) should include: model, gpu_type, pool_size, region, expected sustained qps, duration_weeks. Example YAML we accept in the form:
```
model: gptj-13b-v1
pool_size: 2
gpu_type: a100-80gb
region: us-west-2
duration_weeks: 4
expected_qps: 5
priority: poc
```
- VPC peering requirements: customer account ID, target CIDR (no overlap), 2 private subnets, egress ports (443). We'll create the peering connection and configure one-way NAT if customer needs outbound internet.
- IP allowlist: customer NAT/public IP(s) or CIDR. For quick test a /32 is fine; can be expanded later.

liu (infra): Security groups: allow outbound 443; inbound TCP 22 only for our jumpbox if requested. Note: Private deployment (on-prem/VPC package) is a separate offering and has ~2-3 week lead time.

devops-bot: infra-request #249 created by liu: https://internal.redwood/infra/requests/249  status: pending approval :robot_face:

jordan (acct_mgr): Customer asked about BYOK and audit logs  can Dedicated use customer-managed keys? If not, we should propose Private for their BYOK requirement. Also they want a cost estimate for SOW.

anya (security): BYOK for Dedicated is possible but requires compliance paperwork and security review. Private supports KMS integration out of the box. I'll begin DFD review once they return the questionnaire.

maria (sales_eng): I'll create the hosted API key today scoped to project tag "finflow-poc". Which Console path to use?

liu (infra): Console -> Projects -> [finflow-poc] -> API Keys -> Create Key. Recommended scopes: "inference:generate", "billing:view". For test keys set max_tokens_per_min to 60k.

kevin (solutions): Pricing estimate for SOW: 2x A100 reserved for 4 weeks + egress/storage for KV cache. Rough ballpark: $18k/week for pool reservation -> ~72k for 4 weeks before discounts. Hosted dev usage add ~$800. I'll refine when we lock model/sequence length.

maria (sales_eng): I'll mark costs as estimates and send questionnaire to customer asking for network contacts + NAT/public IP.

anya (security): When you send questionnaire, add: "Are you sending PII? If yes, DPA and CSAT required; include contact for legal/compliance."

kevin (solutions): Quick test runbook to include in POC doc:
1) create hosted key and run: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate`
2) after pool ready, include header `X-Redwood-Pool: finflow-poc-pool` in requests and run 50 concurrent calls from their harness.
3) check p95/p99 tail latency under target (200ms). Fallback: route to hosted model `gptj-13b-v1-fallback` if pool offline.

liu (infra): I'll attach peering template and minimal routing policy to the infra request. Expect 1-2 business days for approval given throughput justification.

maria (sales_eng): Action items: 1) maria create hosted key + share to customer (today), 2) liu submit infra request and share link (today), 3) anya send security questionnaire (today), 4) kevin draft estimate into POC doc (EOD). I'll chase network contacts.

kevin (solutions): I'll also add a short note about canary rollout + rollback policy so they know how model regressions are handled.

maria (sales_eng): Thanks everyone  I'll post hosted key ID and infra request link here once done. :thumbsup:
